content.short: dRPC provides multichain RPC infrastructure with smart routing, monitoring, and scalable node access for apps on Mantle.
content.description: dRPC is a blockchain infrastructure provider focused on modular RPC services for apps and chains that need network access at scale. Its official site highlights multichain endpoints, smart routing, monitoring, geo-distributed infrastructure, pay-as-you-go access, and self-hosted options for teams that want more control. Rather than serving as a user-facing app, dRPC is backend infrastructure that helps developers route requests efficiently and observe reliability across environments. On Mantle, it fits as RPC and node-access tooling for builders who need performance, redundancy, and flexible deployment.
